# FDG4069

> DO declare known values for a strongly typed string via static get-only properties on the type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.11 Strongly Typed Strings.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: whether a type is a strongly typed string is a matter of intent that symbols do not show.

## From the book

The enum-like IntelliSense experience is a very strong motivator for strongly typed string types.
